source: Bilibili BV1yz411q7XE — FitMen六六「22個拉伸動作詳細講解」(14:47). Static stretches after training; hold ~30 s each side (video 03:06, 14:10). Main session mapped trained muscles → stretches; user decided 2026-09-25: stretching happens only in the LAST break of the day, after all training, and it counts toward pass/fail.

zh: 靜態拉伸，輕輕拉到有感覺就好，不用太大力
en: Static stretch — ease in until you feel it, no forcing

chest.name: 胸肌拉伸
tips: 手舉高抓住柱子，做弓步
身體向前壓，感覺胸肌被拉開
tips_en: Grip a post overhead, step into a lunge
Lean forward until you feel it across the chest

lat.name: 背闊肌拉伸
tips: 雙手抓住柱子，屈髖、屁股往後坐
感覺不明顯就一次拉一邊
tips_en: Hold a post with both hands, hinge and sit your hips back
Not feeling it? Do one side at a time

side_body.name: 側面拉伸
tips: 做箭步，身體向側面倒並撐住
拉到整個側面，包括腹斜肌
tips_en: Split stance, lean sideways and brace
Stretches the whole side, obliques included

rear_delt.name: 三角肌後束拉伸
tips: 手臂橫過胸前，大拇指朝身體後方
另一手把手臂往身上拉
tips_en: Arm across the chest, thumb pointing back
Pull it in with the other hand

side_delt.name: 三角肌中束拉伸
tips: 手臂橫過胸前，大拇指朝外
另一手扣住手腕往身上拉
tips_en: Arm across the chest, thumb pointing out
Pull it in at the wrist with the other hand

front_delt.name: 三角肌前束拉伸
tips: 坐在地上，雙手撐在身後
屁股慢慢往前移、上身後仰，打開胸口和肩膀前側
tips_en: Sit on the floor, hands planted behind you
Slide your hips forward and lean back to open the chest and front shoulders

biceps.name: 肱二頭肌拉伸
tips: 手靠在支撐物上
身體往反方向轉
tips_en: Hand against a support
Turn your body away from it

triceps.name: 肱三頭肌拉伸
tips: 舉手、彎肘
另一手輕輕往反方向扳
tips_en: Raise the arm and bend the elbow
Gently press it back with the other hand

glute.name: 臀部拉伸
tips: 扶住柱子，一腳腳踝搭在另一腳膝蓋上
屁股往後往下坐，感覺臀部被拉開
tips_en: Hold a post, cross one ankle over the other knee
Sit your hips back and down until you feel it in the glute

quad.name: 股四頭肌拉伸
tips: 抓住腳背往後拉
膝蓋朝下，身體站直
tips_en: Grab your foot and pull it back
Knee pointing down, stand tall

hip_flexor.name: 髂腰肌拉伸
tips: 半跪弓步，後腳膝蓋著地，髖部往前推
骨盆不要前傾，上身和地面垂直
tips_en: Half-kneeling lunge, back knee down, push the hips forward
Keep the pelvis neutral, torso upright
